desktop.notes:
• Moving to _keep / _discarded takes every file with the photo's name - looked up in the folder at that moment, so files an editor wrote after the scan (RapidRAW .rrdata, .xmp, .dop…) go along too; undo brings them all back. A different photo (IMG_10, "IMG_1 (1)") is never taken along.
• Editor files left behind earlier are found after a scan; Cullect asks once whether to move them to their photos (nothing is overwritten).
